summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Golf Channel Games Rematch
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy will captain opposing teams with mostly new lineups for the 2026 Optum Golf Channel Games in Florida on December 16.

items.headline: Bryson Stands by LIV Golf 2
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau remains the only major player fully backing LIV Golf 2 amid the breakaway league's efforts to secure its 2027 future.

items.headline: DeChambeau’s Emotional US Open Win
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau reflected on the deep emotions behind his second major title at the 2024 US Open.
